page.overview:
Who is Kanna?

He is the son of a carpenter, who was the master carpenter thirty years prior the series. He supervised the rebuilding of Konohagakure, where he hired a lot of foreign help, among others, Gennō.

He seemed like a kind man, eager to help the Konoha 11 with their requests. He also seemed organised, knowing where each document he has is located. He is also very proud, stating he could never face the Fifth Hokage again, since he let the blueprints be stolen.

He has short black hair, and a black full beard, as well as small black eye brows. He also has light brown eyes and a white headband. he wears a white shirt with a purple jacket over it and a black pair of pants, which also go around his feet.

He held a meting with the Konoha 11, where Shikamaru receives a list on which is written all the blueprints that where stolen by Gennō. He proceeds to tell them how Gennō got to the village, and gives Shikamaru Gennō's fake letter of recommendation. He later was surprised when Shikamaru learned that several other blueprints where also missing.
